title: Global Semiconductor Architecture: High-NA EUV and CoWoS Packaging
content: Advanced semiconductor manufacturing has transitioned to sub-2nm process nodes utilizing High-NA EUV lithography systems manufactured by ASML. Chipmaker packaging has become the primary bottleneck, with TSMC's CoWoS (Chip-on-Wafer-on-Substrate) and Intel's EMIB seeing unprecedented demand for AI accelerators like NVIDIA Blackwell and AMD Instinct. Thermal design power (TDP) for enterprise racks has reached 120kW per cabinet, necessitating liquid-to-chip cooling loops.
author: Semiconductor Industry Research

title: Hyperscale Datacenter Economics & Power Infrastructure
content: Hyperscalers including Microsoft, Google, and Amazon are increasingly signing direct nuclear energy Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) to support gigawatt-scale AI computing campuses. Capital expenditures (CapEx) for server infrastructure are projected to exceed $250 billion, with network interconnects (InfiniBand and 800G/1.6T Ethernet) comprising 18% of total hardware cluster costs.
author: Cloud Infrastructure Quarterly

title: Global Central Bank Liquidity & Sovereign Bond Dynamics
content: Central bank balance sheet normalization (Quantitative Tightening) has created elevated volatility in long-dated sovereign debt markets. Financial equity valuations in the technology sector remain highly sensitive to real 10-year Treasury yields, with discount rate models implying a 15x to 28x forward price-to-earnings multiple depending on earnings growth acceleration in generative AI software.
author: Global Macro Policy Group
